versions.changelog:
Initial release of stock-analysis-expert with comprehensive A-share nine-dimension analysis system.

- Delivers professional stock analysis covering policy, fundamentals, technicals, funds, ESG, and behavioral finance.
- Features in-depth policy cycle evaluation, multi-dimensional financial metrics, technical indicator combinations, and real-time fund flow tracking.
- Includes risk assessment, valuation comparison, and actionable buy/sell signals.
- Generates expert-level stock analysis reports with investment suggestions.
- Applicable for personal or institutional investors in the China A-share market.
